metadata.purpose: Experiments supporting the Group 09 report: basic greedy heuristic + three agreed report-level techniques, tested sequentially and by ablation.

technique_3.name: Opponent modelling
technique_3.source_multiplier_note: The current source agent uses opponent_multiplier=0.0 in all stages, so a non-zero value is required to genuinely evaluate Technique 3.

metadata.reproducibility: Each seed runs in a fresh subprocess with PYTHONHASHSEED, random.seed, and numpy.random.seed set to the same seed. Opponent class lineups use a separate deterministic RNG so they remain matched across configurations.

01_basic_greedy.name: 01_basic_greedy
01_basic_greedy.description: Greedy shortest-path/supply-centre distance heuristic only; the three report techniques are OFF and extra tactical/opponent scoring terms are neutralised.

02_plus_tactical_planning.name: 02_plus_tactical_planning
02_plus_tactical_planning.description: Sequentially adds Tactical multi-unit planning to the previous report experiment stage.

03_plus_long_term_strategy.name: 03_plus_long_term_strategy
03_plus_long_term_strategy.description: Sequentially adds Persistent long-term strategy to the previous report experiment stage.

04_plus_opponent_modelling.name: 04_plus_opponent_modelling
04_plus_opponent_modelling.description: Sequentially adds Opponent modelling to the previous report experiment stage.

05_without_tactical_planning.name: 05_without_tactical_planning
05_without_tactical_planning.description: Starts from the common all-report-techniques condition and removes only Tactical multi-unit planning.

06_without_long_term_strategy.name: 06_without_long_term_strategy
06_without_long_term_strategy.description: Starts from the common all-report-techniques condition and removes only Persistent long-term strategy.

07_without_opponent_modelling.name: 07_without_opponent_modelling
07_without_opponent_modelling.description: Starts from the common all-report-techniques condition and removes only Opponent modelling.

08_final_agent_reference.name: 08_final_agent_reference
08_final_agent_reference.description: Exact source agent: no test-time switch or weight changes. This is kept separate because the current source uses opponent_multiplier=0.0, whereas the Technique 3 experiment uses an explicit non-zero ON value.

02_plus_tactical_planning.meaning: Sequential: this configuration minus the previous development stage.
